ads.text: Telugu on-grid creative - PM Surya Ghar free-electricity scheme, switch to Eastman on-grid solar solutions for the Rs. 78,000* subsidy plus additional state subsidy. Call 80016 80016.

Telugu hybrid creative - switch to Eastman hybrid solutions for the Rs. 78,000* subsidy plus additional state subsidy, with Eastman hybrid inverters and lithium batteries for 24x7 power. Call 80016 80016.

ad_library.summary: Eastman New Energy is running 4 active Telugu ads on Meta (Aug 29 - Sep 29, 2026) - on-grid and hybrid creatives, both selling the Rs. 78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy plus an additional state subsidy - and all four send the click to eastmansolar.in. Eastman is not a local installer: the site is a manufacturer's product catalogue (800 MW in-house panel manufacturing, 1000+ distributors, 400+ OEM partners, part of the Eastman group's 25 GW production).

funnel.meaning: At least the spend lands on an owned site. But the destination is a manufacturer's product catalogue - on-grid, off-grid and hybrid inverter pages - while the ads promise a B2C subsidy. The gap between the ad promise and the page is where the conversion leaks.

findings: 4 live Telugu ads (Aug 29 - Sep 29, 2026), on-grid and hybrid creatives, all pointing at eastmansolar.in - the spend stays on an owned domain.
But the destination is a manufacturer's catalogue: 800 MW in-house panel manufacturing, 1000+ distributors, 400+ OEM partners, panels from 50W to 590W - a B2B story for ads selling a B2C subsidy.
The enquiry form runs behind reCAPTCHA and a character-limited 'claim your subsidy of Rs 78,000' field - friction between the ad promise and the lead.
Every ad ends with the same 80016 80016 short-code number - a call-centre funnel, not a local-installer one.
Scale note: this is the solar arm of the Eastman group (25 GW group-wide production), not a local installer - the pitch here is the B2C funnel, not the product.
next_steps: Build a dedicated residential PM Surya Ghar page
The ad promise is 'reduce your bill to zero with Rs 78,000 subsidy'. The page should be a residential subsidy calculator and quote form, not the inverter catalogue.
reCAPTCHA plus a limited field on a Rs 78,000 offer loses clicks. Fewer fields, no captcha on the first step.
Install pixel and retargeting on the offer
4 ads on one offer with no pixel means no way to see who dropped off after the click and no audience to bring back.
Test on-grid vs hybrid against the page
Two creatives selling two product lines to one funnel - a landing page per line tells you which converts.
